reviews.title: underrated cooler
reviews.comment: good price, high quality, mounting is easy. and cools extremely well. zero point in buying a cooler from expensive brands *cough* noctua when you can pick something up like this for 20 bucks... also this genuinely looks more aesthetically pleasing than most high end coolers of this size lol.
reviews.author: LittlePotato

reviews.title: Reduced Temp. By 20c
reviews.comment: I replace the stock Intel cooler for my i7 8700. This reduced the CPU temperature by 20c. Just buy this fan it works!
reviews.author: DJ Wilson

reviews.title: Great product, horrible installation. PITA!
reviews.comment: The cooler works great, but the installation manual is absurd. The metal clamps make this installation take a looong time trying to get them to clamp around the heatsinks. The value is great for such an inexpensive CPU fan. My temps are amazing! The fan is very quiet. Highly recommended, but just know you may need to look up YouTube videos for some instructions.
reviews.author: A. Palladini
